item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Dog Catches a Flying Frisbee

turns.text: Make a realistic 5-second widescreen video of a golden retriever catching a red frisbee in a grassy park. One continuous shot with the camera staying still, no sound.

item.tests: Tests text-to-video generation of one readable action with a visible, physically coherent catch in a single shot.

answer_sheet.Source image: No photo; generate it from the description.
answer_sheet.Style and setting: Realistic golden retriever in a grassy park; lighting is your call.
answer_sheet.Action: The dog catches a flying red frisbee in its mouth.
answer_sheet.Camera, text and audio: Stationary camera, one continuous shot, no text or sound.

must_haves: A realistic golden retriever is visible in a grassy park.
A red frisbee visibly travels toward the dog before being caught in its mouth.
The frisbee remains identifiable through the catch rather than disappearing or passing through the dog.
The five-second widescreen clip is one continuous shot with a stationary camera.
